title: Solving equations and compound angles
intro: Read this before solving trigonometric equations and using double angles.

blocks.title: solving equations
blocks.body: Find the **principal value** with the inverse function, then use the symmetry of the graph for the other solutions in the range. For $\sin x=k$: $x$ and $180^\circ-x$. For $\cos x=k$: $x$ and $360^\circ-x$. For $\tan x=k$: $x$ and $x+180^\circ$.
For $\sin2x=k$ in a range $0^\circ$ to $360^\circ$, solve for $2x$ in the **doubled** range $0^\circ$ to $720^\circ$, then halve.

blocks.title: the slips
items: Do not divide an equation by $\sin x$: you lose the solutions where $\sin x=0$. Factorise instead.
In $\cos(A+B)$ the sign between the products is **minus**.
